title: parse_rfc3339 accepts trailing garbage after the seconds when the string ends in Z
property: a timestamp with extra characters between the seconds and the final Z is not a valid RFC3339 timestamp and must be rejected
actual: Ok(UNIX_EPOCH): weak parser only checks b[19]=='Z' and len<=25, ignoring the remaining bytes
evidence: Docs say parse_rfc3339 is for strictly programmatically generated strings; only 'Z' or '+00:00' suffix is supported. 'ZZ' and 'Zabc+00:00' are not valid RFC3339 (the crate's own tests reject '+00:00abcd' and similar trailing junk).
